text: @tirol/dsh-language-set 是一款 DSH 提示词插件：通过 systemPrompt 服务分别设置 AI 回复和思考时使用的语言。它注入两个可独立配置的提示词段，并可用自定义文本替换默认提示；启用 command 后还能查看当前配置和已注入的提示内容。适合希望固定或区分回复语言与思考语言的 DSH 用户；配置可使用全局语言及两项单独语言，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

@tirol/dsh-language-set sets reply and thinking languages through DSH systemPrompt sections. Configure each language, customize its prompt, and inspect configuration and prompts with an optional command. It suits users wanting distinct AI languages without an API key or external service.
想让 DSH 的回复固定使用中文。
能不能把 AI 回复语言和思考语言分别设置？
我希望给模型注入指定回复语言的系统提示。
让 DSH 默认用我配置的语言回答。
我想自定义控制回复和思考语言的提示文本。
怎样查看当前生效的语言提示内容？
Set a default language for DSH replies through system prompts.
I want the model’s reply language and thinking language configured separately.
@tirol/dsh-language-set 的功能「分别设定回复与思考语言」：插件向 systemPrompt 添加两个独立提示段，分别控制回复用户和思考时使用的语言；各自语言为空时回退到全局 lang。
@tirol/dsh-language-set 的功能「自定义语言提示」：配置 replytext 或 thinkingtext 后，对应提示段使用自定义文本；留空时生成基于所选语言的默认提示。
@tirol/dsh-language-set 的功能「查看配置与提示」：启用 command 配置且 commands 服务可用时注册 language 命令；输入 config 可查看配置，输入 show 可查看调试模式下保存的提示段。
@tirol/dsh-language-set 使用前须知：内置语言描述只将 zh-CN 映射为简体中文，其他语言代码都会映射为 English；系统提示文本也会按此描述生成。（见 src/index.ts:19-26）

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that controls AI's reply language and thinking language separately via system prompt injection.

@tirol/dsh-language-set README · Install from Source Code：```bash
git clone https://github.com/Emck/tirol-dsh-language-set.git
cd tirol-dsh-language-set

pnpm install

@tirol/dsh-language-set README · Usage：After successful installation, restart the DSH service to take effect immediately. The default language is Chinese.

Modify `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` configuration to change the language (currently only Chinese and English are supported).

@tirol/dsh-language-set README · Features：- **Reply Language Control** — Controls the language AI uses when replying to users
- **Thinking Language Control** — Controls the language AI uses for internal thinking
- **Flexible Configuration** — Supports seven configuration options
- **Command Support** — Optionally registers the `language` command

@tirol/dsh-language-set README · Configuration：| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|------------|
| `lang` | `string` | `'en-US'` | Global default language |
| `replylang` | `string` | `''` | Reply language, falls back to `lang` when `''` |
| `thinkinglang` | `string` | `''` | Thinking language, falls back to `lang` when `''` |
| `replytext` | `string` | `''` | Reply prompt text, customizes the default template |
| `thinkingtext` | `string` | `''` | Thinking prompt text, customizes the default template |
| `command` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to enable the `language` command |
| `verbose` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to enable verbose logging mode |

@tirol/dsh-language-set README · Configuration Example：Edit `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` to add plugin configuration:

```yml
- id: dsh-language-set
  config:
    lang: "zh-CN"
    command: true

@tirol/dsh-language-set README · Built-in Commands：When `command: true`, the plugin registers a `language` command:

```bash

@tirol/dsh-language-set README · DSH Plugin Specification：This plugin follows the DSH Cordis plugin specification:

- **Plugin Identifier** — `export const name = 'dsh-language-set'`
- **Service Dependency** — `export const inject = ['systemPrompt']`
- **Effect Registration** — `ctx.effect()` returns a dispose cleanup function
- **Schema Validation** — `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` Schema validation
